description: Renovate covers the default container images and the base image of each Dockerfile. Dependabot keeps the Go modules and the actions.
The schedule is weekly, so one batch of updates arrives on one day. The shared presets set no schedule.

customManagers.description: The container images a RedisFailover runs when it names none of its own. Each constant holds a tag and the digest it resolves to, and both move together.

packageRules.description: One pull request for a round of default image updates. A digest that moves under an unchanged tag is a rebuilt image, and it rides along rather than opening a pull request of its own.
